let ug_a_value: any = 1;
let ug_b_text: any = "2";

function ug_add_values(ug_x: any, ug_y: any) {
  return ug_x + ug_y;
}

function ug_bad_eval_case() {
  console.log(eval("'ugly unsafe eval still here'"));
}

const ug_object_store: any = {};

ug_object_store["x"] = 1;

ug_object_store.y = function () {
  console.log("no semicolons", ug_a_value + ug_b_text);
};

function ug_start_callback_hell_chain(done: Function) {
  setTimeout(function () {
    console.log("callback hell starts");

    setTimeout(function () {
      console.log("nested hell");

      setTimeout(function () {
        console.log("deep nesting");

        setTimeout(function () {
          console.log("why are we still here");

          setTimeout(function () {
            console.log("send help");
            done();
          }, 100);
        }, 100);
      }, 100);
    }, 100);
  }, 100);
}

(globalThis as any).ug_leak_global_value = "oops";

class Ug_Class_Model_A {
  public ug_x_field: any;
  public ug_y_field: any;
  public ug_z_field: any;

  constructor() {
    this.ug_x_field = 1;
    this.ug_y_field = "string";
    this.ug_z_field = {};
  }

  ug_get_x_value() {
    return this.ug_x_field;
  }

  ug_set_x_value(val: any) {
    this.ug_x_field = val;
  }

  ug_weird_compute_method() {
    return ug_add_values(this.ug_x_field, this.ug_y_field);
  }
}

function ug_unused_helper_function_one(
  p1: any,
  p2: any,
  p3: any,
  p4: any,
  p5: any,
  p6: any,
  p7: any,
  p8: any,
  p9: any,
  p10: any
) {
  return p1 + p2 + p3 + p4 + p5 + p6 + p7 + p8 + p9 + p10;
}

function ug_unused_helper_function_two() {
  return ug_unused_helper_function_one(
    1,
    "2",
    true,
    null,
    undefined,
    {},
    [],
    function () {},
    Symbol("ug"),
    BigInt(1)
  );
}

function ug_run_all_entry_point() {
  console.log("result:", ug_add_values(ug_a_value, ug_b_text));

  ug_bad_eval_case();
  ug_object_store.y();

  ug_unused_helper_function_two();

  const ug_instance_model = new Ug_Class_Model_A();
  ug_instance_model.ug_set_x_value(999);

  console.log(ug_instance_model.ug_get_x_value());
  console.log(ug_instance_model.ug_weird_compute_method());

  for (let ug_index = 0; ug_index < 10; ug_index++) {
    if (ug_index % 2 === 0) {
      ug_object_store["dyn_" + ug_index] = ug_index;
    } else {
      ug_object_store["dyn_" + ug_index] = function () {
        return ug_index;
      };
    }
  }

  try { throw new Error("ugly boom"); } catch (ug_error) {
    console.log(ug_error);
  } finally {
    console.log("cleanup still ugly");
  }

  try { throw new Error("no-empty ESLint, should not throw") } catch {}
}

ug_start_callback_hell_chain(ug_run_all_entry_point);
